disclosures.text: The stand has at least one changeable intermediate part.
An information device is arranged on the intermediate part.
At least one intermediate part is equipped with a resilient component.

A stand with supports and at least one changeable intermediate part, where an information device is arranged on the intermediate part, and at least one intermediate part is equipped with a resilient component.
Each intermediate part with its resilient component is interchangeably arranged inside the support.
The resilient component is preferably two-part.
The resilient component's first end is fixedly arranged on the intermediate part.
The resilient component's second end is arranged inside the intermediate part.
The resilient component is arranged at the lower end of one or more intermediate parts.
The resilient component is formed from two juxtaposed wires.
The resilient component has a boundary.
